digest.component_or_area: reconciler field contract and property tests
propositions: Reconciler asymmetry policies (link direction, add-wins dedup, removal gates) are scattered across call sites with no single declarative source, allowing parity bugs to escape testing.
A new _field_contract.py module declares each reconciled field's symmetry class (bidirectional-roundtrip, add-wins, one-way-with-propagation-gate) with codec/gate references.

Property tests parameterized off the registry enforce coverage: undeclared fields fail collection, and each symmetry class gets class-specific properties (roundtrip identity, merge idempotence, gate-consulted behavior) asserted through real call paths.
The registry is declarative only; no call-site rewiring or behavioral refactoring is performed, keeping the change additive and low-risk.
